subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should release owners publish a stable package/parity hotfix for the affected 2026.6.11 dist, or keep this issue open until the next stable release carries the fixed bundle?
rationale: The source fix is already on main, but the remaining work is release packaging and user-facing stable-version guidance, which automation should not decide without maintainer release intent.

options.title: Publish stable parity fix
options.body: Cut and validate a stable package containing the current reentrant writer and reply-init fixes, then close this issue with package proof.

options.title: Wait for next stable train
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical affected-stable tracker until the next stable release ships the fixed bundle.

options.title: Document affected stable only
options.body: If no hotfix will ship, explicitly mark 2026.6.11 affected and point users to the safe upgrade path before closing.

recommendation.title: Publish stable parity fix
recommendation.body: Cut and validate a stable package containing the current reentrant writer and reply-init fixes, then close this issue with package proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is release/package handling, and this person is connected to the current latest stable release tag.
